title: Kiln Pi package
responsibility: Be the installable unit Pi loads for this project: a declared package manifest naming its extensions, skills and prompts; a registration entry point; and a machine-readable capability signature that any consumer — the supervisor, the canary, a delegation verifier — can compare against what it expected to be loaded.
notes: ⚠️ THE COMMITTED PACKAGE ENTRY MUST BE PORTABLE. `pi install -l` writes whatever it writes; the entry that ends up in a committed settings file has to be a separator-normalised relative literal that resolves to the same directory on another operator's machine, and it may be normalised only after canonical equivalence to what Pi wrote is proved. An absolute path here breaks every clone. ⚠️ THIS COMPONENT PUBLISHES A DECLARATION; IT DOES NOT IMPLEMENT ITS CONSUMERS. The responsibility says any consumer CAN compare what loaded against what it expected, and that is a property of the declaration being machine-readable and versioned - not a promise that this component builds those comparisons. Each one is owned and accepted elsewhere: the capability tool returning the declaration unchanged is TSK-0045's, on CMP-0032; a delegation refusing a child whose signature is missing or drifted is ACC-0075's, on CMP-0036; the canary's record invalidating when what it measured changes is ACC-0062's, on CMP-0030; and refusing to launch at all over a project whose trust is not approved is ACC-0051's, on CMP-0026, which is already accepted. ⚠️ THE PACKAGE DIRECTORY IS WHERE THE COMMITTED ENTRY POINTS. TSK-0030 writes `../.planning/pi-package` into the project's settings, relative to `.pi/`; in a consumer install the tool is at `<project>/.planning/`, so that entry resolves to this component's own directory at the tool root. Until it exists, the entry that is committed points at nothing.
